fields.Description: AIRE Ancient Baths London is an adults-only thermal-bathing experience set in a restored historic building near Covent Garden. The visit centres on moving through a sequence of warm, hot and cold baths, steam and flotation spaces, with massages and private rituals available as add-ons or packages. It is closer to an immersive bathing experience than a conventional treatment-led spa.
fields.Editorial Summary: Adults-only thermal-bath venue in Covent Garden with hot, warm, cold and saltwater pools, a steam room, massages and longer bathing rituals. Sessions are capacity-controlled and must be booked in advance.
fields.Good To Know: Advance booking is required and weekends can sell out. Arrive early and bring swimwear; towels, robe, footwear and toiletries are provided. The experience is adults-only and is not suitable during pregnancy.
fields.Name: AIRE Ancient Baths London

fields.Description: Akasha at Hotel Café Royal is a central London hotel wellness club combining a lap pool, Watsu pool, sauna, steam room, private hammam, treatment rooms, gym and studio classes. Public visitors can book treatments and spa-day experiences, while hotel guests and Akasha members have broader access routes. The value is in the breadth of facilities rather than a single headline treatment.
fields.Editorial Summary: Akasha sits beneath Hotel Café Royal and combines substantial pool and thermal facilities with spa treatments, personal training and movement classes. Public visitors can book treatments and spa-day packages; broader access also comes through hotel stays or membership.
fields.Good To Know: Mixed access. Treatments and spa-day experiences are publicly bookable, while broader pool, sauna, hammam, gym and class access depends on the package, hotel stay or membership held.
fields.Name: Akasha Holistic Wellbeing Centre

fields.Description: The Sanctuary is a Shoreditch social wellness club combining open and guided sauna and cold-plunge sessions with Reformer Pilates, hot yoga, strength classes, events and an on-site café.
fields.Editorial Summary: A Shoreditch social wellness club where sauna and cold plunge sit alongside guided sessions, movement classes and a café.
fields.Address: 114-116 Cheshire St, London E2 6EJ, United Kingdom
fields.Good To Know: Open sauna, guided sauna and movement classes follow separate timetables. Public class packs and memberships are available; check the live schedule for the booking format and current inclusions.
fields.Atmosphere: Social and contemporary, with recovery, movement, events and café time designed to work as one longer visit.
fields.Social & Community Note: The Sanctuary is built around shared and guided activity rather than only individual treatments. Open and guided sauna/cold-plunge sessions sit alongside Reformer Pilates, hot yoga, strength classes, events and a café, giving people several reasons to return and interact beyond a single recovery session.
fields.Name: The Sanctuary — Shoreditch
fields.Editorial Verdict: Best for people who want sauna and cold plunge as part of a broader social wellness experience, rather than a purely private recovery session.

fields.Description: Arc Canary Wharf is a communal contrast-therapy space with social connection built into the experience. The core offer is a large shared sauna and ice baths, with Guided Classes, Free Flow sessions and dedicated evening socials. Arc After Dark turns contrast therapy into a social event with DJs, guided ice baths, immersive sound and aromatherapy, while the Connect Lounge gives people a place to pause, hydrate and spend time together before or after sessions. Arc also runs workshops and community events, so it is designed to be more than a place to complete a sauna-and-plunge circuit and leave.
fields.Editorial Summary: Arc is London's first communal contrast therapy club, offering a unique blend of sauna and ice bath experiences designed to promote physical and mental well-being. Located in Canary Wharf, Arc provides guided and self-guided sessions that combine traditional wellness practices with modern social connection.
fields.Address: Unit 46, Minus Level, 1 Crossrail Place, Canary Wharf, London E14 5AR
fields.Good To Know: Public booking. Choose between guided and self-directed formats in the live timetable. The sauna and ice baths are communal, so expect a shared session rather than a private room.
fields.Social & Community Note: Community and social connection are a major part of Arc's proposition, not just a by-product of the shared sauna. Alongside Guided Classes and Free Flow, Arc runs evening socials such as Arc After Dark and 'sweat and connect' sessions, as well as workshops and other community events. The 60-person communal sauna and dedicated Connect Lounge are designed to create space for conversation and time together around the contrast-therapy session. Public single sessions, packs and memberships are available; this is not a selective private members' club.
fields.Name: Arc

fields.Description: A west-London steam-banya and bathhouse with plunge pool, treatment rooms and a dedicated booth and lounge area.
fields.Editorial Summary: Banya No.1 Chiswick combines traditional steam-banya sessions with cold plunge and optional treatments in a full bathhouse setting.
fields.Good To Know: Published access starts from £35 for 90 minutes. Treatments and Parenie are booked separately.
fields.Name: Banya No.1 — Chiswick
fields.Editorial Verdict: A substantial west-London bathhouse option with transparent entry pricing and a more ritual-led experience than a standard sauna studio.

fields.Description: An authentic Russian-style steam-banya experience with cold plunge, bucket shower, Parenie treatments and public or private sessions.
fields.Editorial Summary: Banya No.1 Hoxton centres on high-humidity steam, cold immersion and traditional Parenie treatments rather than a conventional dry sauna circuit.
fields.Good To Know: Public, private and gender-specific sessions are available. Check the live booking calendar for current packages and prices.
fields.Name: Banya No.1 — Hoxton
fields.Editorial Verdict: A distinctive bathhouse listing whose ritual-led format and private-hire option broaden the directory beyond Nordic-style sauna.

fields.Editorial Summary: A specialist DEXA location for users who want a body-composition baseline, a separate bone-density assessment, or both. The scan purpose matters because the two reports answer different questions.

fields.Good To Know: DEXA Body Composition and DEXA Osteo are separate £189 services. Confirm which scan answers your question; the combined Body & Bone package covers both.

fields.Editorial Verdict: A focused option for repeatable DEXA measurement, with body-composition and bone-density services clearly separated.

fields.Description: BXR LAB is the recovery and treatment space attached to BXR's Marylebone fitness club. The LAB offer is centred on short, bookable recovery appointments such as infrared sauna and cold plunge, alongside steam, massage and body treatments. It is useful for someone who wants a focused recovery session without necessarily joining the wider BXR club.
fields.Editorial Summary: A performance-led Marylebone recovery space with infrared sauna, cold plunge, steam and bookable body treatments.
fields.Good To Know: Mixed access. LAB appointments can be booked separately from the wider club membership. Choose the live session length and treatment during booking; access to other BXR facilities should not be assumed unless included.
fields.Name: BXR LAB

fields.Description: Claridge's Spa is the Mayfair hotel's treatment and wellness space, with seven treatment rooms, sauna and steam facilities, a relaxation pool, fitness studio and a rotating programme of resident and visiting practitioners. The experience is treatment-led and hotel-based rather than a public leisure club, with facility access depending on the booking route.
fields.Editorial Summary: Claridge’s Spa combines hotel-spa facilities with restorative treatments, specialist residencies and a distinctive relaxation pool in a central Mayfair setting.
fields.Good To Know: Mixed access. Treatments can be booked directly, but pool, sauna, steam and other hotel facilities may depend on the treatment, package or hotel stay selected. Check the exact inclusion before booking.
fields.Atmosphere: Quiet, highly polished and intimate, designed around restorative treatment and luxury hospitality rather than high-volume spa access.
fields.Name: Claridge’s Spa
fields.Editorial Verdict: A well-known Mayfair option with publicly bookable treatments; confirm whether the chosen treatment or package includes access to the pool and thermal facilities.

fields.Description: Cloud Twelve is a Notting Hill wellness club and clinic combining a thermal spa with treatment, medical and bio-hacking services. The shared spa side includes infrared and rose saunas, steam, Himalayan salt room and ice bath, while the clinical and longevity offer extends into diagnostics, IV therapies, acupuncture, nutrition, aesthetics and other one-to-one services. Public visitors can book spa visits and treatments without becoming members.
fields.Editorial Summary: Three-floor Notting Hill club with a public-booking spa, wellness clinic, salon and family facilities. The spa includes infrared and rose saunas, steam room, salt room and cold plunge, while clinic services range from IV infusions and acupuncture to nutrition and psychotherapy.
fields.Address: 2-5 Colville Mews, Notting Hill, London W11 2DA
fields.Good To Know: Mixed access. Spa visits and treatments can be booked directly without membership; membership is for ongoing club access and benefits. The thermal facilities are shared, while many clinic and bio-hacking services are individual appointments.
fields.Social & Community Note: Cloud Twelve combines publicly bookable spa and treatment visits with an ongoing membership model. Thermal facilities such as sauna, steam, salt room and ice bath are shared, while many clinical, treatment and bio-hacking services are individual appointments.
fields.Name: Cloud Twelve

fields.Description: Community Sauna Baths Camberwell is part of a not-for-profit community-sauna network focused on affordable, accessible shared bathing. The Ruskin Park site combines communal saunas and cold plunges with the operator's wider programme of community sessions, events and outreach. It is better understood as a local community wellness space than simply an outdoor sauna facility.
fields.Editorial Summary: A Ruskin Park sauna-and-plunge site with three saunas, four temperature-graded cold plunges and accessible facilities.
fields.Address: Ruskin Park, Denmark Hill, London SE5 8EL, United Kingdom
fields.Good To Know: Standard sessions start from £9.50, with lower concession pricing for eligible visitors. After the park closes, use Denmark Hill Gate; the last session begins at 20:00.
fields.Atmosphere: Parkside, communal and informal, with sunset views and a more spacious outdoor feel than a studio-based contrast venue.
fields.Social & Community Note: The social element at Camberwell goes beyond sharing a sauna. Community Sauna Baths runs community-focused sessions, events and outreach across its London network, including work with local groups and social-prescribing routes. The communal sauna and plunge format supports repeat local use, while the live timetable determines which organised sessions are running at Camberwell itself.
fields.Name: Community Sauna Baths Camberwell

fields.Description: Community Sauna Baths Hackney Wick is the operator's flagship community-sauna site, with multiple shared saunas and cold plunges alongside a programme designed to bring people back regularly rather than treat sauna as a one-off appointment. In addition to normal public sessions, the site hosts recurring community sessions and events, including formats created for specific groups, making the social programme a meaningful part of the venue rather than just a consequence of communal bathing.
fields.Editorial Summary: A community-led Hackney Wick venue offering Finnish-style sauna, cold plunge and showers in an outdoor, social setting.
fields.Good To Know: Community sauna and cold-plunge sessions in Hackney Wick. Book ahead and check the live session listing for current prices, towel policy and accessibility details.
fields.Atmosphere: Communal, outdoor and energetic. More community bathhouse than luxury wellness club, which gives it strong editorial colour.
fields.Social & Community Note: Hackney Wick has one of the clearest community programmes in the directory. Alongside public sauna sessions, Community Sauna Baths runs recurring sessions such as Trans Sauna, Mamma Swim and 50+ Women's Sauna, as well as wider events and community programming. The operator also works with local organisations and social-prescribing routes. This is a venue where community activity is part of the product, not simply people sharing the same sauna.
fields.Name: Community Sauna Baths Hackney Wick

fields.Description: Community Sauna Baths Peckham is the operator's simpler off-grid site at Glengall Wharf Community Garden, with two shared wood-fired saunas and a refreshing shower rather than cold plunges. It still sits within the same not-for-profit community-sauna model, where affordable access, shared bathing and organised community activity are central to the wider proposition.
fields.Editorial Summary: An affordable off-grid Peckham sauna with two wood-fired cabins, a cold shower and no plunge pools, set inside Glengall Wharf Community Garden.
fields.Address: 64 Glengall Road, London SE15 6NF, United Kingdom
fields.Good To Know: Sessions run Friday to Sunday and cost £8 for 75 minutes. The site has no cold plunge, and its simple off-grid setup is reflected in the lower ticket price.
fields.Atmosphere: Calm, green and tucked away inside a community garden; simpler and more rustic than the operator's larger sauna-and-plunge sites.
fields.Social & Community Note: Peckham's facilities are simpler, but the venue is still part of Community Sauna Baths' wider community-led network. The organisation runs events, outreach and community sessions across London, while this site places a shared wood-fired sauna within a community-garden setting. Check the live programme for events specific to Peckham.
fields.Name: Community Sauna Baths Peckham

fields.Description: Community Sauna Baths Stratford is a public East London sauna and cold-plunge site within a wider not-for-profit community-sauna network. Three shared saunas and three plunges provide the core experience, while the operator's broader model includes community sessions, events, outreach and lower-cost access initiatives. That makes the venue more than a simple pay-per-session sauna, even though the exact organised programme varies by location and date.
fields.Editorial Summary: A community-led Stratford venue for outdoor sauna, cold plunge and social contrast-therapy sessions.
fields.Good To Know: Public community-sauna sessions in East Village, Stratford. Check the live booking page for current session times, prices and inclusions before travelling.
fields.Atmosphere: Accessible, community-led and outdoor sauna/cold-water recovery energy in East London.
fields.Social & Community Note: Stratford sits within Community Sauna Baths' wider community-led model. The organisation runs events, community sessions, outreach and social-prescribing routes across its London network, while the Stratford venue provides a shared local setting for regular sauna and cold-plunge use. Check the live timetable for organised sessions at this site rather than assuming every network event runs here.
fields.Name: Community Sauna Baths Stratford

fields.Description: Community Sauna Baths Walthamstow is part of a not-for-profit community-sauna network built around affordable, accessible shared bathing rather than private wellness appointments. The Walthamstow site combines communal saunas and cold plunges with the wider operator's programme of community sessions, events and outreach. The emphasis is not simply on using a sauna alongside other people, but on creating a repeat local space where people can meet through sauna and cold-water bathing.
fields.Editorial Summary: A large community sauna site in Walthamstow with four saunas, four cold plunges, accessible facilities and bookable social heat-and-cold sessions.
fields.Address: 47 Sutherland Rd, London E17 6BH, United Kingdom
fields.Good To Know: Standard sessions start from £9.50, with lower concession pricing for eligible visitors. The last session begins at 20:00, and street parking is limited.
fields.Atmosphere: Social and outdoors, with a community garden and firepit alongside a larger sauna-and-plunge setup than the operator's smaller sites.
fields.Social & Community Note: Community is part of the operating model at Community Sauna Baths. Alongside normal public sessions, the organisation runs community-focused sessions, events and outreach across its London network, including work with local groups and social-prescribing routes. Walthamstow's shared saunas and plunges give that wider programme a physical setting for repeat local use. Check the live timetable for events running at this specific site.
fields.Name: Community Sauna Baths Walthamstow

fields.Description: Harley Street preventative-health provider offering a Healthy Heart assessment with CT heart imaging, CT coronary angiography, ECG, carotid ultrasound and blood testing, followed by senior-physician review.
fields.Editorial Summary: A comprehensive imaging-led heart assessment rather than a basic ECG check. It combines coronary imaging and risk measures with physician interpretation and an onward referral route.
fields.Good To Know: This is a medical, imaging-led assessment rather than a simple heart-health check. Ask about suitability, contrast and radiation exposure, and why each investigation is appropriate for your risk profile.
fields.Name: Echelon Health
fields.Editorial Verdict: Strongest fit for users specifically comparing advanced, physician-reviewed cardiovascular imaging within a wider preventative assessment.

fields.Description: City of London membership club with expansive cardio and strength training, yoga, group fitness, cycling and Pilates studios, personal training, eucalyptus steam rooms and a full-service spa.
fields.Editorial Summary: A performance-led City club with substantial training space and a practical recovery offer through eucalyptus steam rooms, spa bodywork and Pilates.
fields.Good To Know: The club is membership-led. The official location page publishes separate spa hours but does not clearly confirm non-member spa access; check eligibility directly before booking.
fields.Atmosphere: A five-floor City club centred on large cardio and strength areas, dedicated studios, member spaces and spa facilities.
fields.Social & Community Note: Membership and recurring studio classes support repeat use, with shared training, lounge and recovery spaces serving the City audience.
fields.Name: Equinox Bishopsgate
fields.Editorial Verdict: A strong fit for City professionals who want premium training, group classes and steam-room recovery in one club.

fields.Description: Kensington membership club with an open-plan strength floor, boxing, yoga, cycling and Pilates studios, personal training, a steam room and a full-service spa. Spa appointments are offered to non-members.
fields.Editorial Summary: A broad West London fitness and wellness club where the strongest recovery elements are the steam room and full-service spa, supported by extensive training and studio facilities.
fields.Good To Know: Club facilities require membership. The official club page states that spa appointments are open to non-members, so access depends on whether you are booking the spa or using the wider club.
fields.Atmosphere: A large premium club built around a naturally lit strength floor, dedicated studios, member lounge and spa.
fields.Social & Community Note: Membership, scheduled group classes and a member lounge create repeat interaction, while spa treatments can also be booked independently by non-members.
fields.Name: Equinox Kensington
fields.Editorial Verdict: Best suited to users who want premium training and studio choice with spa and steam-room recovery in the same Kensington membership.

fields.Description: Premium St James’s fitness club combining personalised coaching, strength and cardio floors, Studio Pilates, hot dry sauna and eucalyptus steam facilities, spa bodywork and skincare, and Hypervolt recovery.
fields.Editorial Summary: A highly personalised Equinox club with premium training, Pilates, sauna and steam facilities, plus a full-service spa that can be booked separately by non-members.
fields.Good To Know: The wider club is membership-led, while the official location page states that spa appointments are open to non-members. Confirm current membership pricing and any separately charged recovery services directly.
fields.Atmosphere: A smaller executive club combining private coaching, refined member facilities, spa treatment rooms and specialised recovery services.
fields.Social & Community Note: The format is more private and individually coached than group-led, with shared member facilities supporting a club setting around the training and recovery programme.
fields.Name: E by Equinox St James’s
fields.Editorial Verdict: Best for users seeking personalised premium training with sauna, steam and spa recovery in St James’s; non-members can book spa appointments.

fields.Description: Chelsea longevity and performance clinic offering physician-led programmes, diagnostic mapping, biological-age and genomic testing, metabolic, hormone, gut and immune assessments, IV and NAD+ therapies, HBOT, cryotherapy, red light therapy and ozone therapy.
fields.Editorial Summary: HUM2N combines clinician-led health assessment with recovery and performance services. It suits people looking for a broad, programme-based approach rather than a single test or treatment.
fields.Address: 35 Ixworth Place, London SW3 3QX, United Kingdom
fields.Good To Know: HUM2N operates as a clinic rather than a traditional wellness studio. The service catalogue includes a 12-month physician-led longevity programme, diagnostic mapping, biological age/genomic assessments, metabolic and gut health testing, HBOT, whole-body cryotherapy, red light therapy, ozone therapy, IV infusions, NAD+ and performance-focused protocols. Advance consultation is recommended.
fields.Name: HUM2N
fields.Editorial Verdict: One of the directory’s broadest clinic-led listings, covering diagnostics, preventative health, cellular therapies and performance support in one location.

fields.Description: An accessible public spa inside a Grade II listed Islington leisure centre, centred on traditional Turkish baths, sauna and relaxation facilities, with pay-as-you-go, day-pass and membership routes.
fields.Editorial Summary: Ironmonger Row Baths provides one of central London’s more accessible traditional bathing experiences, combining Turkish baths and sauna with public leisure-centre pricing and facilities.
fields.Good To Know: Different facilities have different timetables. Check the Spa Experience schedule before travel; the official page also identifies a women-only Tuesday morning session.
fields.Atmosphere: Historic and functional rather than hotel-luxury, with a community leisure-centre setting and traditional bathing focus.
fields.Social & Community Note: Ironmonger Row offers a shared public-spa format through casual bookings, day passes and memberships. The communal Turkish-bath and sauna setup is the relevant social feature; it is not a private members' club.
fields.Name: Ironmonger Row Baths — Spa Experience
fields.Editorial Verdict: A public, comparatively affordable place to use traditional Turkish baths and sauna in a Grade II listed leisure centre.

fields.Description: Victoria performance club combining boxing and conditioning studios with a dedicated recovery suite containing a six-person Nordic sauna and Glacier cold plunge. The club also includes changing facilities, a lounge and an in-house health café.
fields.Editorial Summary: JAB SW1 places boxing-led training and contrast recovery in one compact club. Its recovery suite is clearly specified rather than treated as a generic changing-room amenity.
fields.Address: Unit 5, Colonnade Walk, 151 Buckingham Palace Road, London SW1W 9SZ
fields.Good To Know: The detailed membership selector lists Original membership at £275 per month, including training and recovery, but the same official SW1 page still carries a £225 headline. Confirm the live rate before joining. Public sessions and class packs are also offered.
fields.Atmosphere: A compact, mid-century-inspired club with low-lit training studios, a dedicated recovery suite, lounge and health café.
fields.Social & Community Note: Group training, member programming, a lounge, health café and published social events create several repeat points of interaction beyond the boxing sessions.
fields.Name: JAB SW1 Victoria
fields.Editorial Verdict: A useful Victoria option for users who want coached performance training with sauna and cold plunge built into the same club routine.

fields.Description: KXU is a Chelsea fitness and wellness club with open-gym access, coach-led classes, personal training and a medi-spa treatment offer. Unlike a traditional private members' club, it is a commercial fitness venue with straightforward paid access routes. The strongest reason to choose it is the ability to combine training, classes and recovery or treatment appointments in one central Chelsea location.
fields.Editorial Summary: A pay-as-you-go Chelsea fitness and wellness club offering classes, personal training, massage, spa treatments and a cryotherapy chamber.
fields.Address: 241 Pavilion Rd, London SW1X 0BP, United Kingdom
fields.Good To Know: Public paid access rather than selective private-club membership. Classes, open gym and treatments are booked separately; check the live timetable and treatment menu because availability varies by service.
fields.Atmosphere: Chelsea boutique fitness/wellness energy. Premium and polished, but not clearly a current specialist recovery destination without further validation.
fields.Name: KXU — Chelsea

fields.Description: Lanserhof at The Arts Club is a Mayfair preventative-health clinic offering general and functional medicine, health screening and MRI, musculoskeletal and sports medicine, physiotherapy, osteopathy, cardiology, sleep medicine and nutrition. Its treatment menu also includes cryotherapy, IV infusion therapy, NESA therapy, pain management and massage. Medical appointments do not require Arts Club membership; gym, personal training and studio classes are member services.
fields.Editorial Summary: A multidisciplinary Mayfair clinic combining preventative medicine, imaging and performance assessment with treatment and rehabilitation.
fields.Address: 18 Dover St, London W1S 4LT, United Kingdom
fields.Good To Know: Mixed access. Lanserhof's medical clinic is publicly bookable and Arts Club membership is not required for medical appointments. Gym access, personal training and studio classes such as yoga and Reformer Pilates are members' services and require the relevant club access.
fields.Atmosphere: Clinical, elite and highly polished. More Mayfair medical-wellness club than accessible spa, with strong appeal to longevity and performance audiences.
fields.Social & Community Note: The medical clinic and the private club should be treated as two different access routes. Medical appointments can be booked without Arts Club membership, while the gym, personal training and studio classes form part of the members' club offer.
fields.Name: Lanserhof at The Arts Club

fields.Description: London Cryo St John's Wood offers bookable recovery treatments including whole-body cryotherapy, infrared sauna, red light therapy, compression, HBOT, IV therapy and massage.
fields.Editorial Summary: A St John's Wood recovery studio offering cryotherapy alongside infrared sauna, red light, compression, HBOT and other bookable treatments.
fields.Address: 82 St John's Wood High Street, London NW8 7SH
fields.Good To Know: The St John’s Wood clinic is publicly bookable, with walk-ins also welcomed by the venue. Booking ahead is the safer option if you want a specific treatment or time.
fields.Atmosphere: Clinical recovery rather than spa. Useful for users who already know they want cryotherapy, sports recovery or cold-treatment protocols.
fields.Name: London Cryo — St John's Wood

fields.Description: London Cryo Belgravia offers bookable recovery treatments including whole-body cryotherapy, infrared sauna, red light therapy, compression, HBOT, IV therapy and massage.
fields.Editorial Summary: Whole-body cryotherapy in Belgravia, with infrared sauna, red light therapy, compression, HBOT, IV therapy and massage also available.
fields.Good To Know: Book through LondonCryo’s website or app and select the Belgravia location. Service availability can vary by branch, so confirm the chosen treatment and live appointment time during booking.
fields.Name: London Cryo — Belgravia

fields.Description: An outdoor sauna village in leafy North London with five saunas, six cold plunges, hot showers and changing facilities. Designed for heat, cold and rest, with social recovery, solo sessions, private sauna hire and full-site private hire available.
fields.Editorial Summary: Outdoor Kentish Town venue with five saunas, six cold plunges, hot showers and changing facilities. It offers social sessions, solo bookings and private hire, with lower off-peak prices.
fields.Address: 44 Caversham Rd, London NW5 2DS, United Kingdom
fields.Good To Know: Finnish sauna and cold-plunge sessions in Kentish Town. Peak and off-peak prices can differ; use the live booking flow for the selected time.
fields.Atmosphere: Outdoor sauna village feel: social, functional and recovery-led, with enough scale for solo users, groups, standard sessions, private sauna hire and full-site private hire.
fields.Social & Community Note: Lowlu Kentish Town combines shared sauna and cold-plunge sessions with solo sessions and private sauna hire. Its social offer comes from the communal session format, while visitors who want less interaction can choose a more private route.
fields.Name: Lowlu Kentish Town

fields.Description: A purpose-built communal contrast-therapy venue inside Rocket Padel, with two Finnish saunas, three cold plunges and both social and silent session formats.
fields.Editorial Summary: Lowlu Ilford combines spacious Finnish sauna and cold immersion with a choice between sociable and quieter session formats.
fields.Address: Wellness Suite, Rocket Padel, 2 The Drive, Ilford IG1 3PS
fields.Good To Know: Bring two towels: one to sit on and one to dry with. Peak sessions are £16.50; off-peak sessions start at £12.50.
fields.Atmosphere: Purpose-built communal sauna and plunge space inside Rocket Padel, with separate social and silent saunas plus rest areas.
fields.Social & Community Note: Social Sauna is conversation-friendly; Silent Sauna provides a quieter shared session.
fields.Name: Lowlu Sauna — Ilford
fields.Editorial Verdict: A useful east-London contrast option with unusually clear session formats, long opening hours and transparent off-peak pricing.

fields.Description: A Wandsworth sauna and cold plunge escape with social and silent saunas, two saunas and three plunges. A strong South London option for group-friendly heat and cold exposure.
fields.Editorial Summary: A strong South London addition for Well+, with 2 saunas, 3 plunges and a clear social/silent sauna positioning.
fields.Address: 2 Armoury Way, London SW18 1SH, United Kingdom
fields.Good To Know: Public sauna and cold-plunge sessions are booked through Lowlu. Check the live booking page for the current session format, availability and price before travelling.
fields.Atmosphere: Polished outdoor social sauna and plunge setting with both social and silent sauna positioning.

fields.Description: Sæl Spa is a private members’ wellness club at Fulham Pier combining a rooftop thermal spa with recovery technology, movement and clinician-supported longevity programmes.
